text_block_list.text: We're at the autumn Tenno Sho and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон has stupefied the
audience with her
incredible
performance!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон wasn't on top of her game
today,
but I saw something in that
run—something to
look forward to in her
next races!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
As for Нарита Брайан... From what it looks
like, she's
yet to make a complete
recovery post-comeback.
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан stands there, a prodigy
stripped of
her former strength. Hushed
conversations begin
to ripple through
the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Are her injuries not fully healed or
something? I
wonder if she'll ever be
able to make a full
recovery like this...
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
Will we ever be able to see Нарита Брайан
in her
prime again?
text_block_list.name: Fan B
Хиши Амадзон
choice_data_list:
Doesn't look like Нарита Брайан's back in top form
yet.

text_block_list.text:
No, but I could feel it comin' back to her
as we
ran.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like there's something
missing. But
what could it be?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach! Let's head back to Tracen
and do
some uphill sprints!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She shouldn't have the energy to run
inclines right
after a G1... but I ask her
motive nonetheless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm startin' to see what I need to do.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
And in order to see that through, I've
gotta aim
high.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
That's... abstract, but I can tell she's
serious. If
this is what it takes to make
the one-on-one with
Brian a reality, so
be it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To fans, the pair's rivalry might look
different
now... but I know they haven't
changed a bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: All right, let's do it then!

text_block_list.text:
And so, we pour our efforts into training,
day
after day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A few days later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, we have an impressive racer with
us. She's
taking the world by storm with
her amazing
running skills, and has won
a slew of G1 races...
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
And that racer is none other than Hishi
Amazon!
Thank you for agreeing to be
interviewed right
before the Japan Cup!
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text: Thanks, the pleasure is mine!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
To start, I recall you naming Нарита Брайан
your
rival at the Arima Kinen last year...
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
But who would you say is your rival for
the Japan
Cup?
text_block_list.name: Interviewer

text_block_list.text:
My rival is the same as always—Narita
Brian! I'm
gonna work hard to overcome
her!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
It's no secret that Нарита Брайан has been
in poor
health, so the entire room leans
in, curious to
hear the rest of Hishi
Amazon's answer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I know she's been off her game, and I
know her
fans are feeling let
down—worried.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She isn't back to runnin' like the beast
you knew.
That speaks for itself, but...
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She's not done just yet. I'm sure you
know this as
well as I do.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан isn't strong just because
she's
"talented."
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She's strong because she never stops
running.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон's frank declaration stuns
the press
conference hall into still
silence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about her.
She's gonna
be okay.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: She's the Нарита Брайан, y'know. She'll be able to make her way back to the top, no matter what.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Who my rival is will never change.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Her stance on the matter spreads
through the
media like wildfire...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that interview with
Hishi
Amazon? The one where she said
Нарита Брайан is
still her rival.
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I did. I've gotta admit, her speech
really hit
me in the heart...
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
And she's right, y'know? The look on
Narita
Brian's face when she runs is just
as fierce as it
always was.
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
Slowly, the public's opinion of Narita
Brian begins
to shift.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do this, Teach!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I watch as Хиши Амадзон, strong and
gallant as
ever, sprints up the incline.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's not much longer now until the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
